input: I paid ₹3,499 for headphones on 2 November. The refund is pending.

guidance: Save order confirmation, invoice, payment proof and relevant photos/chats.
Write to the seller and platform grievance officer, stating the remedy requested.
If unresolved, register a pre-litigation grievance with the National Consumer Helpline at 1915 or consumerhelpline.gov.in.
If still unresolved, review filing options on e-jagriti.gov.in and consider advice from a qualified consumer-law practitioner.
